plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero for capital preservation.
Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and meet single-name limits.
Reduce leveraged AI/Software (METU, PLTU) exposure.
Increase SPY to 25% for broad index stability and quality.
This plan aims for capital preservation and lower drawdown.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for lower volatility. Expect smaller swings, but also more modest growth potential.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to meet the 5% combined limit.
Adjust QQQI to 25% to maintain concentration within limits.
Reduce leveraged AI/Software (METU, PLTU) exposure.
Buy XLV at 4% as a strong, diversified scanner setup.
This plan balances risk and growth, reducing overall leverage.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and diversifies slightly. Expect moderate swings with a reasonable growth outlook.

plan: Increase leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to press existing positions.
Add to leveraged AI/Software (METU, PLTU) for growth.
Add MSFU at 6% as a strong scanner setup.
Trim QQQI to 20% to make room for higher-beta adds.
This plan leans into leverage and concentration for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases leveraged exposure and concentration, which amplifies both potential upside and drawdown. Be aware that leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this mode can lead to substantial losses quickly if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero.
Sell high-beta sector (SMH) and single names (CRWD, METU, SNOW, PLTU) to near zero.
Rotate into income-focused ETFs like QQQI, JEPQ, JEPI, SPYI (not explicitly listed as buys, but implied strategy).
Prioritize low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
This plan aims to park cash for yield and monthly distributions.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, prioritizing steady distributions and low drawdown. It eliminates nearly all leveraged and high-beta holdings. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a market selloff.
